quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M1-A: Numbers to 3] Count the counters on the frame: there are 3 counters. Which numeral matches this quantity?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Touch each counter once as you count in order from 1 up to 3. The last number said (3) tells the total cardinality.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M1-A: Numbers to 3] Start at 2 and count forward 1 more. What number comes next?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Each successive number name refers to a quantity that is exactly 1 larger: 2 + 1 = 3.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M1-A: Numbers to 3] If we rearrange 3 cubes from a straight line into a circle, how many cubes are there now?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The total number of objects (3) stays the same regardless of their arrangement.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M9-TT: Fractions of shapes] Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2 on the number line?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 2/4 lands on the exact same midpoint between 0 and 1 as 1/2.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M9-TT: Fractions of shapes] Compare two fractions of the same whole: 2/6 ___ 2/3.
sampleQuestions.explanation: When numerators are the same (2 parts), sixths are smaller pieces than thirds because the whole is cut into more shares.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M9-DDD: Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] A rectangular garden is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide. What is its area in square feet?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Tile 6 rows of 4 unit squares: Area = length × width = 6 × 4 = 24 square feet.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M9-DDD: Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] Which attribute is a DEFINING attribute of every triangle?
choices: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.explanation: Color, size, and orientation do not change a shape; 3 closed straight sides and 3 vertices define a triangle.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M9-DDD: Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] A rectangle has a perimeter of 20 cm and a length of 7 cm. What is its unknown width?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Two lengths equal 7 + 7 = 14 cm. Subtract from 20 cm: 20 - 14 = 6 cm for the two widths, so each width is 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M10-EEE: Describe multiple measurable attributes of a single object (length & weight) and sort categories by count (K.MD.1, K.MD.3)] Count the counters on the frame: there are 3 counters. Which numeral matches this quantity?

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M10-EEE: Describe multiple measurable attributes of a single object (length & weight) and sort categories by count (K.MD.1, K.MD.3)] Start at 2 and count forward 1 more. What number comes next?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Each successive number name refers to a quantity that is exactly 1 larger: 2 + 1 = 3.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-M10-EEE: Describe multiple measurable attributes of a single object (length & weight) and sort categories by count (K.MD.1, K.MD.3)] If we rearrange 3 cubes from a straight line into a circle, how many cubes are there now?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The total number of objects (3) stays the same regardless of their arrangement.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-E8-MM: Color and number words] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-E8-MM: Color and number words] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?

sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [K-E8-MM: Color and number words] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).
